Application Data.NAME: Happy Paws Pet Grooming
Application Data.MAILING ADDRESS: 123 Happy Paws Lane, Suite 100, Springfield, IL 62704-5678
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Happy Paws Pet Grooming provides high-quality pet grooming and retail services for dogs, cats, and small mammals. Our operations include bathing, haircuts, and nail trimming, performed by certified staff trained in animal handling and safety protocols. We maintain a clean and safe environment with proper ventilation, non-slip flooring, and secure animal enclosures. Our retail offerings include premium pet food, toys, and grooming supplies, all sourced from licensed, reputable suppliers. We prioritize the health and safety of animals in our care, adhering to all veterinary and regulatory guidelines. Additionally, we conduct online sales with robust cybersecurity measures in place to protect customer data.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 06/15/2021, a dog in our grooming facility suffered a minor injury to its paw while receiving a trim. The cause was determined to be a grooming tool malfunction. The veterinary bill for the treatment amounted to $400. The claim was paid, and the matter has been resolved.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B, Grade II, UL Listed
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Chain link fencing with security cameras and monitored alarm system.
